en_title: Rainbow Six: Vegas Reportedly Returning With New Installment
cn_title: 据报道，《彩虹六号：维加斯》将推出新作回归
opus_summary: 据Insider Gaming报道，育碧已批准蒙特利尔团队开发《Rainbow Six: Vegas》系列新作，代号为「Spades」。消息人士称，新作预计更像续作而非重制版，但名称尚不明确。该团队据称还在开发另外两个项目，其中至少一款可能以《Rainbow Six》世界为背景。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft has reportedly given a new entry in the Rainbow Six: Vegas series the green light and a codename.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，育碧已批准开发《彩虹六号：维加斯》系列的一部新作，并为其确定了一个代号。

paragraphs.en: Details on a long-awaited (and unexpected) return to a fan-favorite corner of the Rainbow Six universe come from an Insider Gaming report. The publisher is said to have given its Ubisoft Montreal team the go-ahead to begin work on a new Vegas installment, with two other projects reportedly also in the works there.
paragraphs.cn: 有关《彩虹六号》宇宙中一处深受粉丝喜爱的领域期待已久（且出人意料）的回归，相关细节来自Insider Gaming的一篇报道。据称，发行商已批准其 育碧Montreal团队开始开发一部《维加斯》新作，据报道，该团队还有另外两个项目正在开发中。

paragraphs.en: Rainbow Six: Vegas started with the release of the original game in 2006 before it returned for a sequel in 2008. Whether the new game will be called Rainbow Six: Vegas 3 or something else is unclear, though the site's sources say it's expected to be more like the former rather than something like a remake. It also stated that it's being worked on with the apt codename, "Spades."
paragraphs.cn: 《彩虹六号：维加斯》系列始于2006年推出的初代游戏，随后于2008年推出了一部续作。目前尚不清楚新游戏会被命名为《彩虹六号：维加斯3》还是其他名称，不过该网站的消息人士称，预计它更可能是前者，而不是重制版之类的作品。报道还称，这款正在开发中的游戏有一个贴切的代号：「Spades」。

paragraphs.en: That's just one of the three games the Montreal studio is reportedly working on. The report wasn't able to confirm much about the remaining projects but said one source suggested at least one other game is planned to take place in the Rainbow Six universe in some capacity.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，这只是Montreal工作室正在开发的三款游戏之一。该报道未能确认其余项目的太多信息，但称一名消息人士透露，计划至少还有一款游戏以某种形式发生在《彩虹六号》宇宙中。

paragraphs.en: The Rainbow Six franchise as a whole existed long before popular entries like Rainbow Six Siege or even the Vegas series. Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six traces all the way back to the late '90s but has splintered into a wide variety of gameplay experiences and offerings. Siege is no doubt the most well-known iteration today thanks to how Ubisoft has supported its tactical gameplay since its 2015 launch, but the most recent entry actually arrived in 2022 with Rainbow Six Extraction .
paragraphs.cn: 整个《彩虹六号》系列早在《彩虹六号：围攻》乃至《维加斯》系列等热门作品出现之前就已存在。《汤姆·克兰西：彩虹六号》可以追溯到20世纪90年代末，后来分化出了种类繁多的玩法体验和作品。由于育碧自2015年推出《围攻》以来一直支持其战术玩法，它无疑是如今最知名的一作，但该系列最新作品实际上是2022年推出的《彩虹六号：异种》。

paragraphs.en: Despite nearly 20 years passing since the last Vegas game, it's remained a beloved corner of the universe for many. IGN gave the original game a 7.6/10 when it launched for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. We then gave the sequel's limited edition release an 8.4/10 .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管距离上一款《维加斯》游戏推出已过去近20年，它仍是许多人喜爱的系列宇宙中的一部分。初代游戏登陆PlayStation 3和XBOX 360时，IGN为其打出了7.6/10分。我们随后为续作的限定版打出了8.4/10分。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft seems to be still in the early stages of its unannounced Rainbow Six: Vegas continuation, so don't expect to see it launch for at least a few more years. While that may mean we'll have passed the 20-year mark since the last game, we hopefully won't have to wait quite as long to learn more about it. Until then, it's best to keep expectations low while the publisher keeps its cards close to its chest.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧这部尚未公布的《彩虹六号：维加斯》后续作品似乎仍处于早期阶段，因此至少未来几年内不要期待它会推出。虽然这可能意味着它推出时距离上一款游戏已有超过20年，但希望我们不必等那么久就能了解更多相关信息。在那之前，鉴于发行商仍守口如瓶，最好还是降低期待。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, we do know about a few other projects Ubisoft has up its sleeve. Rainbow Six Tactics , for example, was announced in August and will launch sometime next year. A Splinter Cell remake is also in the works, even if it's been a while since we heard from it .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，我们确实知道育碧还在筹备其他几个项目。例如，《Rainbow Six Tactics》于8月公布，将于明年某个时候推出。一款《细胞分裂》重制版也正在开发中，尽管我们已经有一段时间没有听到它的消息了。
